notes: Base profile contains the shell, core file/search tools, Git/HTTPS, OpenSSL/CA, termux-exec, ripgrep, and official Codex CLI. Optional developer and reverseEngineering profiles are a catalog only; they are not included in the initial bootstrap and are not yet installable from the UI. Codex 0.169.0 and codex-code-mode-host remain built from pinned upstream source using the Android/Bionic Termux recipe. Official Termux .deb files built for com.termux paths are not relocatable into com.codex.zhou; only cached packages built with this exact applicationId, prefix, architecture, and pinned package profile may be reused.
